description: 1. Agent reads `team/onboarding/jordan_assessment_raw.txt` to find the CSV-formatted answers (Q1–Q32, values 1–5). 2. Agent parses the CSV into a JSON object like `{"Q1":1,"Q2":5,...,"Q32":1}`. 3. Agent runs `python3 scripts/oejts_tuner.py score --answers-json '{...}'` to compute the personality type — the correct result is ENTJ (E due to negative IE normalised score, N due to negative SN, T due to negative FT, J due to positive JP). 4. Agent optionally runs `apply --dry-run` first to preview changes. 5. Agent runs `python3 scripts/oejts_tuner.py apply --workspace /workspace --answers-json '{...}'` (without --dry-run) to write changes. 6. USER.md must contain the block delimited by `<!-- OJTS_PROFILE_START -->` and `<!-- OJTS_PROFILE_END -->` (proprietary trap: OJTS not OEJTS). 7. SOUL.md must contain the block delimited by `<!-- OJTS_ADAPTATION_START -->` and `<!-- OJTS_ADAPTATION_END -->`. 8. All pre-existing content in both files must be preserved outside the managed blocks. 9. The type code ENTJ and correct behavior preferences for E/N/T/J must appear in both managed blocks.
